properties.name: view
properties.comment: How the items are arranged (see ListViewView). Changing it drops the hot item and column and any revealed cut-off text. Throws std::invalid_argument for an unknown view.
hand: written drops the hot item and column, conceals cut-off text and bumps the model revision before invalidating

properties.name: check_boxes
properties.comment: Whether each item shows a check box (Windows Forms' CheckBoxes); item_checked and set_item_checked read and write the state.

properties.name: multi_select
properties.comment: Whether several items can be selected (Windows Forms' MultiSelect). Turning it off keeps only the focused item selected (or the first selected one) and raises selection_changed when that drops any.
hand: written trims the selection to the focused or first selected item and publishes it

properties.name: full_row_select
properties.comment: Whether the selection highlight spans the whole details row rather than the first column's text.

properties.name: small_image_list
properties.comment: The images of the details, list and small-icon views, looked up by each item's image_key; null for none. Throws std::invalid_argument for a list that is disposed or bound to another window.
hand: prepare refuses a list that is not live or belongs to another window; written resubscribes to its changes

properties.name: large_image_list
properties.comment: The images of the large-icon and tile views, looked up by each item's image_key; null for none. Throws std::invalid_argument for a list that is disposed or bound to another window.
hand: prepare refuses a list that is not live or belongs to another window; written resubscribes to its changes

properties.name: font
properties.comment: The font of the items, headers and label editor.
hand: shared FontCapability<ListView>; written forwards the font to the label editor

properties.name: tile_size
properties.comment: The tile view's tile, in logical units at text scale 1 (Windows Forms' TileSize). The default, an empty size, sizes tiles from the large icon and three lines of text. Throws std::invalid_argument unless both sides are zero, or both are finite and between minimum_tile_side and maximum_tile_side.
hand: written invalidates only while the view is the tile view

properties.name: draw_mode
properties.comment: Content-only owner drawing (owner decision W-Q6; Windows Forms' OwnerDraw with DrawItem and DrawSubItem). In ItemDrawMode::owner_draw the view raises draw_item_content for each painted item's own content (column 0: its icon and text) and, in the details view, for each visible sub-item cell (its column), and in the tile view for each sub-item line shown (its column), in paint order; the item's plate, check box and focus cue stay painted by role, and a handler's draw_default adds the default content. Column headers are not owner-drawn. A handler that changes the view's items, order, columns or view, or disposes it, ends that paint at once; the view is painted again with the change. Throws std::invalid_argument for an unknown mode.
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("ListView draw mode is invalid");

properties.name: show_groups
properties.comment: Whether the items are shown in their groups (Windows Forms' ShowGroups; see groups). On by default.
hand: written drops the hot item, conceals cut-off text and bumps the model revision before invalidating

properties.name: default_group_header
properties.comment: The default group's header; "Default" until set. Throws std::invalid_argument for invalid UTF-8.
prepare: if (!validate_utf8(incoming).valid()) throw std::invalid_argument("ListView group header is not valid UTF-8");

properties.name: label_edit
properties.comment: Label editing (Windows Forms' LabelEdit, ListViewItem.BeginEdit, BeforeLabelEdit and AfterLabelEdit). While label_edit is on, F2 on the focused item, or begin_label_edit, places a TextBox (the `label_editor` part) over the item's text with its text selected. Enter, a press elsewhere in the view, or focus leaving the editor commits the edit; Escape and cancel_label_edit cancel it. Each ended edit raises after_label_edit once, after the editor has closed. A committed label after_label_edit does not cancel becomes an ordinary item's text; in a virtual view the application stores it while handling after_label_edit, and the view shows what the source then retrieves. Replacing or sorting the items, a new virtual source or refresh_virtual_items cancels the edit once the change is made, before any selection event; scrolling keeps it, the editor following its item. A slow second click on the focused item does not begin an edit yet: the host does not report its double-click interval. Turning label_edit off cancels an edit in progress.
hand: written cancels a pending label click and an edit in progress when turned off; it invalidates nothing

not_properties.name: columns
not_properties.reason: a collection edited in place (set_column_width, the sort indicator); collections stay methods

not_properties.name: items
not_properties.reason: a collection edited in place (set_item_checked, sort_items, label edits); collections stay methods

not_properties.name: virtual_source
not_properties.reason: replaces the model (drops the items, reads the count, resets selection and focus)

not_properties.name: focused_index
not_properties.reason: keyboard and selection state written by the view itself in six places (item replacement, sorting, virtual refresh, focus entry) that must not scroll; a cell's written hook would run for each
